data.description: Valerie wants 'more dialect transformation pipelines': the ability to compose/chain transformations rather than one monolithic renderer per dialect, e.g., sexpr base + noisy symbol substitution + whitespace noise. Design a pipeline abstraction over FormRenderer (or a transform layer between canonical form and final rendering) that keeps register_renderer/get_renderer registry compatibility so inspect task -T renderer=... params keep working (possibly a spec string or config dict for composed pipelines). Must preserve determinism under render_seed and record the full transform chain in RenderedForm.metadata so analysis can attribute effects. This unlocks the combinatorially large representation space cheaply — the point is many surface forms per identical structure.

We want to compose dialect transformations instead of writing one renderer per dialect. For example: s-expression base, then symbol substitution, then whitespace noise. Design a way to chain transformations while keeping the existing registry working, so inspect task parameters like -T renderer=... still work. A spec string or config dict could describe a composed pipeline.

Requirements:
- results must be reproducible under render_seed
- RenderedForm.metadata must record the full chain of transformations so analysis can attribute effects
- structure must be preserved at every step

Composition makes the space of surface forms very large at low cost, which is the point of the benchmark.

data.to:
Read .lattice/notes/design-decisions-2026-07-04.md first. It binds this task. This task is load-bearing: DB-2 and DB-3 build on it.

Design the two-layer rendering architecture:
1. Archetype generators produce the most-abstracted rendering of a form in each dialect family.
2. Variation injectors compose on top: layout jitter, symbol substitution, whitespace noise, style changes, distractor content. Endless variations per family come from injection, not from new renderers.

Requirements:
- the existing registry keeps working: inspect task parameters like -T renderer=... still resolve, and a composed pipeline is expressible there (spec string or config dict — decide and justify)
- same seed plus same spec always gives identical output
- RenderedForm.metadata records the ordered chain of archetype and injectors with per-stage config, so analysis can attribute effects
- containment structure is preserved at every stage and asserted between stages
- the existing 5 renderers keep working unmodified or behind a thin adapter
- the design must serve both text and image outputs

data.body: Ultracode foundations run in flight (workflow wf_68d640a4-ddc): 4 codebase readers + 4 external researchers -> 3-proposal design panel -> 3 judges -> synthesis -> 3 adversarial reviewers -> revision. Output lands at .lattice/notes/rendering-architecture-2026-07-04.md and seeds this task's plan. DB-2 and DB-3 planning holds until it lands.

Ultracode foundations run complete (19 agents, wf_68d640a4-ddc). Design doc: .lattice/notes/rendering-architecture-2026-07-04.md (386 lines, marker verified). 3 proposals judged; compat-first skeleton won with structure-first verification and experiment-first provenance grafted in. Adversarial review produced 16 findings (7 major); all 16 fixed in the doc, none dispositioned away. Key fixes: frozen suites now pin an explicit form_id->form_string table plus per-item payload hashes (not just specs+seeds); seed = digest of whole DialectSpec with occurrence-indexed substreams; suite must be an ablation lattice for per-stage attribution; coverage-adjusted contrasts and payload-collision checks protect the paired design. DB-4 planning should now be a thin pass: turn the doc's migration plan into the plan file.

Amendment from Valerie: injectors must declare an applicability set (named archetypes or a whole modality). The spec validator rejects unsupported archetype-injector pairings at admission, before any spend. Generic text injectors stay single implementations; archetype-specific ones (door gaps, boundary jitter) live with their archetype. See the amendments section of design-decisions-2026-07-04.md.

## Adversarial plan review (DB-4) — agent:claire-plan-reviewer-a

Reviewed against the architecture note, the decisions/amendments note, and the real code (renderers/__init__.py, base.py, datasets/factory.py, tasks/single.py, analysis.py, tests/test_renderers.py, svg_circle_renderer.py, sexpr.py). Tried to refute; most attacks failed. No fatal findings. Two major (both prose/ordering, not design), three minor.

### MAJOR 1 — sibling tickets mislabelled (accuracy / could misroute orchestration)
Plan line 5 and the "What unblocks DB-2 and DB-3" section call DB-2 "spatial families" and DB-3 "novel dialects". The Lattice board is the reverse: DB-2 = "Text dialect families: archetypes plus novel self-similar dialects"; DB-3 = "Visual dialect families". The architecture note's prose has this swap, and DB-3's own plan explicitly catches and corrects it ("treat the task descriptions as ground truth"). DB-4 inherited the swap uncritically. Fix: correct line 5 and the unblock section to match the board — DB-2 is text+novel, DB-3 is the nine-family visual taxonomy.

### MAJOR 2 — spatial emit / rasteriser dependency not sequenced
The plan claims DB-2/DB-3 "can start after M2 and proceed in parallel with M3 onward." True for authoring (archetype build + predicate + predicate unit tests run on the symbolic scene, all available at M1/M2, and spatial verify never touches pixels). But the visual task (actual DB-3) cannot emit runnable model-facing PNG stimuli until the pinned rasteriser lands, which the plan only concretely commits in M5.5. M1 lists `emit(base, style)` but defers the spatial->PNG rasteriser to M5.5. Fix: either state that M1's `emit` ships a working spatial->PNG path with the pinned rasteriser, or explicitly note the visual families can author+verify after M2 but cannot produce runnable image stimuli until M5.5. Note this is inherited from the doc's own step 1-vs-step 7 split, so it is faithful, just underspecified.

### MINOR 1 — headline criterion 3 weaker than M5 parity
Acceptance criterion 3 only asserts the five legacy names "return a working renderer." M5's acceptance additionally asserts structural equivalence to the pre-migration output. A lazy alias of e.g. `circle` to a different renderer passes criterion 3. Fix: fold M5's parity assertion into the headline criteria.

### MINOR 2 — composite provenance not guarded by a failable headline criterion
The doc explicitly flags that factory.py's composite branch drops render_metadata (confirmed: the composite Sample metadata at factory.py lines 148-157 carries no render_metadata key). M3/M4 bodies fix it, but none of the 8 headline acceptance criteria test that a composite-dialect Sample carries the provenance chain. A lazy impl passing all 8 could leave the composite branch dropping provenance. Fix: add a criterion asserting a composite Sample carries the ordered provenance.

### MINOR 3 — M1/M4 overlap ambiguous
M1 (line 61) says ComposedRenderer.render already does "fold injectors with per-stage verify... and provenance stamping," yet M4 is where per-stage verify + resample-on-violation + the full provenance schema + roundtrip_ok land. Tighten which is skeleton (M1) vs complete (M4) so the implementer does not double-build or under-build.

### Attack surfaces verified SOUND (tried to refute, could not)
- Faithfulness: the doc's 8-step migration maps cleanly onto M1-M5 (core abstractions, factory fix, canonical, sexpr, noisy_parens, nested_list left as-is, svg_circle reimpl, alias+key=name) plus the shared config-merge helper. Verification/suite/provenance sections land in M4/M6/M7. Nothing material dropped.
- ECS verdict is consistent with the amendment. The validator keys on nominal applicability (archetype/modality names) — exactly what the amendment's admission-time rejection needs. Primitive.tags stays advisory and unused by the validator in v1 (risk explicitly binds this), so it cannot undermine the node-map exactly-once invariant. M6 acceptance directly tests rejection of a bad archetype-injector pairing before spend. No hole.
- M8 ownership: there WAS a latent gap (the doc's "DB-1" = migration ticket, but the Lattice DB-1 is docs-only and explicitly refuses the code). The plan CLOSES it by owning the single.py stamp + analysis.py rewrite in M8. Correct call. Caveat: the plan's "can be lifted into a DB-1 ticket" escape hatch is stale — the existing DB-1 refused this scope, so it must stay in DB-4 or spawn a NEW dedicated ticket, never route back to the docs-only DB-1. Whoever owns it, M8's work items are right.
- The plan's reading of the real code is accurate: factory shares one random.Random across the loop (order-dependence bug real); analysis get_log_metadata has the top-level config.get('mismatched') lookup and the renderer=='parens' default; circle emits data:image/svg+xml and uses math.sin/cos/sqrt/pi with circlify only in the docstring (never imported); sexpr has exactly the 7 presets; registry is dict[str, type[FormRenderer]] with an issubclass guard. All plan claims check out.
- test_renderers.py does NOT test the circle renderer and asserts exact metadata only on the retained old canonical/noisy classes, so M5's alias strategy keeps criterion 4 ("no test_renderers changes beyond additions") satisfiable. My criterion-4-vs-circle-PNG concern is refuted.
- Determinism (1), plumbing/-T (5), payload-hash gate (6), admission gate (7), containment-between-stages (8) all have real teeth.

### Verdict
PASS WITH FIXES. No implementation-level or plan-level rework of the approach. Apply before implementation: (1) swap DB-2/DB-3 labels to match the board; (2) sequence the spatial rasteriser dependency (M1 emit ships it, or note visual families cannot emit runnable stimuli until M5.5); (3) fold M5 parity into criterion 3; (4) add a composite-provenance headline criterion; (5) disambiguate M1 vs M4 verify/provenance scope. The two-layer architecture, the ECS refinement, seed threading, verification, payload hashing, and M8 ownership are all sound.

Review fixes applied: swapped mislabelled DB-2/DB-3 sibling scopes (DB-2=text+novel text dialects, DB-3=nine-family visual taxonomy). Stated DB-4 owns enclosure@1 outright; DB-3 consumes it. Removed the M8 'lift into DB-1' escape hatch — DB-4 owns single.py/analysis.py edits outright, DB-1 here is docs-only. Clarified rasteriser staging for DB-3 (symbolic scenes after M1/M2, PNG emission after M5). Strengthened acceptance criterion 3 to require structural equivalence, not just 'a working renderer'. Added acceptance criterion 9 for composite provenance. Disambiguated M1 (skeleton verify/provenance) vs M4 (full per-stage verification, resample-or-drop, full schema).

Landed DB-4 milestones M1 and M2 only, on branch `feat/DB-4-pipeline-m1-m2`. Everything else (M3 onward) is out of scope for this pass.

What landed (new package `src/lofbench/renderers/pipeline/`):
- `nodes.py`: `FormNode`, `form_to_nodes`/`nodes_to_form` (round-trip tested against hand-picked and 200 generated forms), `containment_relation`, `relation_hash`.
- `archetype.py`: `Primitive` (with the advisory `tags: frozenset[str]` field from the ECS amendment), `BaseRender`, `Archetype` protocol, `induced_relation`.
- `injector.py`: `Injector` protocol with the `applicability` set from the 4 July amendment.
- `emit.py`, `verify.py`, `provenance.py`: skeleton emit (text only), skeleton verify (one hash check after archetype build), minimal provenance stamping.
- `registry.py`: `ARCHETYPE_REGISTRY`, `INJECTOR_REGISTRY` (plain dicts).
- `spec.py` (M2): `DialectSpec` with `from_dict`/`to_dict`/`seed_digest`; `DIALECT_SPECS`; `make_named_dialect_factory` + `register_named_dialect` (kwargs forward into style without mutating the checked-in spec).
- `composed.py`: `ComposedRenderer(FormRenderer)`.
- `renderers/__init__.py` (M2): `_RENDERER_REGISTRY` widened to `Callable[..., FormRenderer]`; `register_renderer` guard relaxed to a callability check; `"composed"` registered so the ad-hoc `-T renderer_config` path constructs.

Decisions / deviations, recorded here per the plan's escalation clause:
1. Root-node exclusion: `form_to_nodes` returns a wrapper root (id `""`) purely to hold zero-or-many top-level marks. It is deliberately excluded from `containment_relation` and from the node-map-exactly-once invariant -- containment is scoped to mark-in-mark nesting, not a synthetic canvas. Not explicit in the doc; this is my interpretive call.
2. Text parse-back default: `induced_relation`'s text path defaults to the canonical parens reader (`form_to_nodes`) via an optional `text_reader` param, since no notation-specific reader exists yet (that's M4/M5 territory for sexpr etc.). Ships the mechanism, not the full per-notation wiring.
3. rng typing deviation: the doc types `Archetype.build`/`Injector.apply` as taking `rng: Generator` (implying numpy, given M3's `SeedSequence`). I typed these as `random.Random` instead, matching the existing `FormRenderer` contract and the codebase's stdlib-only convention. Content-addressed `item_seed`/`SeedSequence` is explicitly M3 scope; revisit the rng type then.
4. M1's skeleton verify runs once, right after the archetype builds, before any injector folds. `render_relation_hash` in provenance therefore reflects the pre-injector state, not the final one -- correct per the plan's explicit M1 scoping ("does not yet implement per-stage verification... those complete in M4"), but worth flagging for the M4 implementer.
5. `"circle"` still resolves to a renderer named `"svg_circle"` (pre-existing asymmetry). The doc explicitly defers fixing this to M5; my registry-key-equals-name test excludes `"circle"` accordingly and documents why.

Verification: `uv run pytest -x -q` -> 110 passed (56 pre-existing + 54 new, all in `tests/test_pipeline.py` and `tests/test_spec.py`; no existing test file modified). `uv run ruff check .` -> 15 pre-existing errors in files I did not touch (`analysis.py`, `core.py`, `factory.py`, `sexpr.py`, `svg_circle_renderer.py`, `test_scorers.py`); zero errors in anything I added or changed. `uv run ruff format` applied to my files.

What M3+ still owes: content-addressed `item_seed`/decorrelated substreams (M3); per-injector re-verification with resample-or-drop and the full `render_provenance` schema (M4); the five-renderer migration including the `enclosure@1` rasteriser (M5); applicability admission gate (M6); frozen suite + payload hashing (M7); task/analysis stamp rewrite (M8). No concrete archetypes or injectors were added -- DB-2/DB-3 build those against this M1/M2 contract.

## DB-4 M1+M2 review (cold) — agent:claire-reviewer-db4

VERDICT: PASS for M1+M2. No implementation-level or plan-level rework needed. No inline fixes required. Do NOT mark DB-4 `done`: M3–M8 remain under this same task id; marking done would falsely claim the whole architecture landed. Status left at `review` for orchestrator to re-scope (spawn M3 or split remaining milestones into a follow-up).

### Gates (verified in worktree, both claims confirmed)
- `uv run pytest -x -q` -> 110 passed in ~1.7s. 54 new tests in test_pipeline.py + test_spec.py; no existing test file modified.
- `uv run ruff check .` -> 15 errors, ALL in untouched files (analysis.py, core.py, datasets/factory.py, renderers/sexpr.py, renderers/svg_circle_renderer.py, tests/test_scorers.py). Zero in any added/changed file. Pre-existing, confirmed by path audit.

### Acceptance criteria (M1+M2 scope) — all met
- DialectSpec determinism: seed_digest is canonical-JSON blake2b; deterministic across two DISTINCT equal objects (not object reuse), and differentiates on every field — injector params, injector order, suite_version, style. Real teeth.
- from_dict/to_dict round-trip: `from_dict(spec.to_dict()) == spec` tested on a fully-populated spec plus a defaults-fill case. Sound.
- Registry widened to Callable[..., FormRenderer]; guard relaxed to `callable()`. The relaxed path IS exercised: register_named_dialect registers a plain factory FUNCTION and it resolves via get_renderer. Legacy five names still resolve; key==name enforced for four (circle exempted, documented, M5-owned).
- ComposedRenderer constructs via spec (test_construct_via_spec) and via **kwargs ad-hoc path (test_construct_via_kwargs_ad_hoc_path -> constructs without TypeError). M2 acceptance met.
- Skeleton verify + provenance: identity render verifies True; a structure-BREAKING text render verifies False (real negative test, not a tautology); end-to-end named-dialect render stamps structure_verified + both relation hashes.
- No gold-plating into M3+: no concrete archetypes/injectors, no numpy, emit() raises NotImplementedError on spatial rather than faking it, DIALECT_SPECS empty. Skeleton stays skeleton.

### Adversarial pass (could a degraded impl pass?)
Mostly no. nodes round-trip runs 200 generated forms; containment_relation asserts exact frozensets including transitive grandparent->grandchild; relation_hash checks order-independence + differentiation; seed_digest differentiates every field; verify has a real failing case. The ONE soft spot: TestNodeMapExactlyOnce is semi-self-referential (builds a node_map from iter_node_ids then asserts it covers those ids). It has a negative arm (pop one, detectable) so it isn't pure tautology, but see finding F2 — there is no production exactly-once checker, only test-local asserts.

### The 5 interpretive decisions — disposition
1. Wrapper-root (id "") excluded from containment/node_map: SOUND. Top-level marks are LoF siblings (juxtaposition/I1), not containment; containment is mark-in-mark only. No M3-M8 problem; archetypes just must not map a primitive to the wrapper (whole-scene canvas = node_id=None decoration, which is supported).
2. Canonical text_reader default for induced_relation: SOUND but see F1. Correct for the parens family; sexpr/other text archetypes must pass their own reader in M4/M5. Caveat: the reader param exists ONLY on induced_relation and is NOT threaded through verify() or render(), and the Archetype protocol exposes no reader hook — so decision-comment's "ships the mechanism" is slightly overstated. Fine for M1/M2 (parens default works, no other text archetype exists yet) but M4/M5 will need a verify()/protocol signature change to carry a per-archetype reader. Flag, not a defect.
3. stdlib random.Random instead of numpy Generator: SOUND, arguably better than the doc. Matches FormRenderer.render(rng) contract + the project's stdlib-preference constraint. The doc's SeedSequence(int) is stdlib-satisfiable (seed random.Random with the blake2b int) so M3 need not pull numpy; this decision nudges M3 toward the stdlib path. No problem.
4. Skeleton verify post-archetype only; render_relation_hash reflects pre-injector state: SOUND — exactly the plan's M1 scoping (line 64). Moot in practice at M1/M2 since no injectors run. M4 completes per-stage.
5. circle/svg_circle asymmetry deferred to M5: SOUND. key==name test still has teeth for the other four names; circle exemption is documented and M5-owned per the doc.

### Findings (all non-blocking, forward-looking handoffs for M4/M5)
- F1 (minor, handoff): text_reader is unreachable from the render pipeline. verify() calls induced_relation(base, pred) without forwarding a reader, and Archetype has no reader attribute. M4/M5 (sexpr/pattern migration) must extend verify()/the protocol or verification will parse non-parens text with the canonical parens reader and mis-verify or raise. Note in the M4/M5 plan so it isn't a surprise.
- F2 (minor, handoff): the node-map exactly-once invariant lives only in test-local asserts; there is no shared checker verify()/admission can call. When DB-2/DB-3 author archetypes they'll each re-derive it. Consider a `assert_node_map_complete(base, root)` helper when the first real archetype lands.
- F3 (trivial): register_renderer's rejection branch (non-callable -> TypeError) and the duplicate-name ValueError are not covered by a test. The acceptance (factory registers/resolves) is covered; only the guard's negative arms are untested.

None of F1-F3 block M1/M2. They are context for the M4/M5 implementer.

STATUS ACTION: left at `review`. Recommend orchestrator route the remaining M3-M8 work (do not close DB-4 as done).

M1+M2 reviewed (pass) and merged to lattice at 38e6729. Routing back to in_progress for M3 to M5. Reviewer handoffs binding on this phase: thread text_reader through verify()/Archetype protocol (F1); provide a shared node-map exactly-once checker for archetype authors (F2); test the register_renderer guard branches (F3). Integration note: ComposedRenderer now raises ValueError when constructed bare (d60714e).

DB-4 M3+M4 fully landed, M5 partial, on branch feat/DB-4-pipeline-m3-m5 (commit fec3423), based on lattice tip d60714e.

M3 (determinism) -- complete: ComposedRenderer.render derives a content-addressed item_seed from spec.seed_digest()+form_string (new pipeline/seeding.py), folding an optional render_seed draw in as an extra digest field so the task-level knob still perturbs composed dialects while staying order-independent. Per-injector substreams are keyed by injector name + occurrence index (reordering distinct injectors leaves draws unchanged; repeated injectors decorrelate). factory.py's create_single_dataset/create_composite_dataset no longer share one random.Random across a batch -- _item_rng derives a fresh, content-addressed generator per item, closing the real order-dependence bug at its source. Composite Sample metadata now carries render_metadata per expression (was dropped entirely before) -- headline criterion 9.

M4 (verification/provenance) -- complete: verify()/induced_relation() thread an optional text_reader per archetype (F1 handoff resolved: ParensArchetype.text_reader is the bracket-agnostic reader, so bracket_swap's non-canonical glyphs still verify; ComposedRenderer.render forwards archetype.text_reader through). ComposedRenderer re-verifies after every injector and resamples up to a capped 5 retries before dropping a violating injector and reverting to the last verified state -- never silently non-isomorphic. provenance.py stamps the full render_provenance schema (suite_version, archetype{name,version}, ordered injector records with applied/resample_count/seed_key, item_seed, both relation hashes, structure_verified, roundtrip_ok, renderer_lib_version). form_id is intentionally absent -- it's task-layer/M8 scope, unavailable to ComposedRenderer which only ever sees a form string. Added assert_node_map_complete, a shared exported checker (F2 handoff), and register_renderer error-branch tests (F3 handoff) -- neither forced onto the render() hot path since doing so would break the pre-existing M1/M2 test fixture in test_spec.py that ships an intentionally empty node_map.

M5 (migration) -- partial, 2 of 5: parens@1 (canonical baseline + bracket_swap injector for noisy_parens, matched and mismatched modes) and pattern@1 (sexpr; 6 of 7 presets as a `preset` injector, byte-identical to the legacy renderer for every migrated preset -- haskell's space-delimited syntax has no bracket a parse-back reader can key on and is intentionally left unregistered, a pre-existing property of that notation, not a regression). Legacy renderer classes are untouched and still registered as-is; the new dialects are additional named entries (parens.canonical, parens.jitter-v1, parens.noisy-v1, parens.noisy-mismatched-v1, pattern.default/lisp/scheme/python/rust/java), not replacements -- "structurally equivalent" is tested via containment-relation parity against the legacy renderer (byte-identical for pattern, since it's deterministic; relation-hash parity for bracket_swap, since both draw randomly from independent seeding schemes).

NOT migrated: enclosure@1 (svg_circle -> platform-stable integer/rational/fixed-point packer geometry, circle-in-circle predicate with epsilon unit tests, pinned rasteriser dependency via uv add cairosvg, PNG data-URI emission, renderer_lib_version stamping) is substantial standalone work per the plan's own framing ("the only substantial code write") and was not attempted this pass -- svg_circle_renderer.py is fully untouched. Also not done: the shared config-merge helper across the five renderer __init__ kwargs loops (hygiene item, no headline acceptance criterion tied to it). Known composability gap: bracket_swap rebuilds its payload from the parsed tree rather than the prior injector's string, so it does not compose with a preceding whitespace_jitter in one spec (documented in injectors/bracket_swap.py) -- register the two in separate dialects until a payload-preserving substitution lands.

Gates: uv run pytest -x -q -> 5288 passed (5206 baseline + 82 new: test_archetypes.py, test_injectors.py, test_determinism.py, test_verification.py, additions to test_pipeline.py). uv run ruff check src tests -> 14 errors, all pre-existing in files not touched this pass (analysis.py, core.py, sexpr.py, svg_circle_renderer.py, test_scorers.py); zero in anything added/changed. No existing test file modified beyond additions.

Remains for M6 (applicability admission gate), M7 (frozen suite + payload hashing), M8 (task-layer stamp + analysis rewrite), and the rest of M5 (enclosure@1, config-merge helper).

## DB-4 M3-M5 review (cold) — agent:claire-reviewer-db4b

VERDICT: PASS for M3+M4+partial-M5 as scoped, on feat/DB-4-pipeline-m3-m5 (fec3423). No implementation- or plan-level rework of DB-4 itself. No inline fixes made. Status left at `review`: M6-M8 and the rest of M5 (enclosure@1, config-merge helper) remain under this task id — do NOT mark done. One HIGH-severity cross-branch merge hazard the orchestrator must sequence around (below); it is a sibling-breakage, not a DB-4 defect.

### Gates (verified in worktree)
- `uv run pytest -q` -> 5288 passed (~8s). Claim confirmed.
- `uv run ruff check` on every touched src/test file -> All checks passed. (14 pre-existing errors remain in untouched analysis.py/core.py/sexpr.py/svg_circle_renderer.py/test_scorers.py.)
- Existing test files: test_pipeline.py +132/-0, test_core.py and test_renderers.py untouched. Criterion 4 met.

### Adversarial checks (all ran with my own scratch scripts)
1. Order-independence (M3, crit 1) — PASS. 40 forms rendered forward vs reversed through content-addressed `_item_rng` -> 0 mismatches. Same 40 under a *shared* `random.Random` -> 40 mismatches. The old bug is genuinely CLOSED at its source, not moved: seeding keys on the form string, not draw position.
2. Content-addressed seeding — PASS. Same spec+form across two fresh ComposedRenderer objects -> byte-identical. Different `suite_version` -> different item_seed and different draws. Occurrence-indexed substreams: two same-name injectors get distinct sub-seeds (decorrelate); distinct injectors keyed by name+occurrence, invariant to list order by construction.
3. Per-stage verification (M4, crit 8) — PASS. A deliberately containment-breaking injector -> `applied=False`, `resample_count=5`, payload reverted to the archetype base, `structure_verified=True`. A flaky injector that can pass -> `applied=True`. Reject-and-revert works; nothing silently non-isomorphic is emitted.
4. text_reader threading (F1) — PASS. Wrote a 10-line non-parens (angle-bracket `<>`) text archetype with its own `text_reader`; it verifies True end-to-end through ComposedRenderer. Same archetype without the reader (canonical parens default) correctly verifies False. F1 is genuinely resolved: verify()/induced_relation both thread the reader, and render() forwards `archetype.text_reader`.
5. M5 structural equivalence (crit 3) — PASS for the migrated 4/5. `parens.canonical` byte-identical to legacy `canonical` on 50 seeded forms; all 6 `pattern.<preset>` byte-identical to legacy `sexpr(<preset>)`. bracket_swap parity is relation-hash, not byte (independent seeding) — sound. `haskell` preset dropped (space-delimited, no parse-back key) — reasonable, disclosed. `circle`/enclosure@1 NOT migrated: still legacy, still emits image/svg+xml. So M5's own acceptance (all five migrated + enclosure predicate tests + no svg mime) is NOT yet met — this is the disclosed partial.
6. Composite provenance (crit 9) — PASS.
